correctness.rationale: Rook graph is the line graph of K_mn, diameter two when both factors ≥2. A selected triple on a geodesic corresponds to a length-three edge path, so GP edge sets are exactly bipartite star forests. The component species are isolated left/right vertices, isolated edge, and oriented center-stars of size≥2, yielding the stated exponential formula. Inclusion-maximal star forests either have no isolates or isolates only in one bipartition with exclusively opposite leaves in stars of degree≥2; restricted Stirling partitions count the latter. Spanning star forests yield every cardinality n..m+n-2 and opposite-side isolate family supplies size m. Independently enumerated all vertex subsets and true geodesic/maximality tests for boards 2×3,3×3,3×4, matching component recurrence and M coefficientwise (3×4 GP 1,12,66,148,117,12 and M=4z³+57z⁴+12z⁵).
